notes: Origin is on the floor at the centre of the complete projected equipment footprint, including the asymmetric +X motor. The conveyor mechanical centreline is therefore offset from the origin; see functional_frame_offset_m. The mutually inconsistent nominal 800 mm transport length, 760 mm drum centres and D50 drums are resolved in favour of the exact component dimensions: bare drums span 810 mm and 3 mm outer PVC wraps span 816 mm. The gearbox extends farther at -Y. belt is the mandated independent 760x150x3 top run, not a translating rigid conveyor loop; the simulator should apply surface velocity toward -Y, leaving its pose fixed. Wraps and return run are decorative frame geometry. Eight collision pieces: belt, two guides, end plate, two beams and two drums. Legs, motor, brackets and optics intentionally have no collision, per the task's small proxy budget. Shallow profile grooves are 0.65 mm deep so beam box proxies stay within the 1 mm outer-surface allowance. Photo-eye dimensions are permuted from 30x20x12 to 12X x30Y x20Z so its optical face points across the belt. Metres, Z up, front -X; all meshes and proxies share the prop origin and identity transforms. Smart UV 66 degrees with 0.01 island margins; 30-degree split smoothing and exported normals. Albedo is CPU Cycles 64-sample diffuse COLOR * (0.4 + 0.6 * AO), 8-bit sRGB; no direct light or highlights. Full procedural Principled PBR and source label UVs are packed in source.blend. Colour grain is centred on nominal colour with about +/-3 percent variation. Generated with Blender 5.2.0 LTS. Task 13 compact OBJ exception: positions use 5 decimal metres where safe; necessary vertices retain up to 6 decimals to preserve nonzero triangles, strict collision convexity and the 0.005 mm Euclidean movement bound. Independent fixed-5 rounding cannot satisfy all three. Normals/UVs use 4 decimals; every original triangle, position index and per-corner attribute value is retained. Equal rounded UV records share indices and visual OBJ indices use shorter equivalent relative notation. No collision remeshing, reindexing or simplification. Task 13 delivery: baked albedos are Lanczos-downsampled to at most 1024 px except the unchanged-resolution factory-floor repeat tile; previews are 512 square. PNG encoding uses RGB8 or reviewed 256-colour Floyd-Steinberg palettes; source artwork pixels and source.blend are retained. Shared PNG paths resolve from this prop folder.
